meta.description: Moving services from Better Life Moving: local, long distance, packing, storage, office, piano and white glove moves, with our own crews and trucks.

hero.h1: Moving Services From Better Life Moving
overview: Twelve moving services, one company doing all of them. Find the job you're planning below and see how it's priced and what the crew brings.
sellingPoints: Our own crews and trucks on every job
Materials and truck costs in the hourly rate
Flat-rate quotes for long distance moves

servicesBlock.intro: Most moves are a mix of two or three of these, a local move with packing, say, or a long distance move with a few weeks of storage in between. One quote can cover all of it.

locationsBlock.intro: Boston is our home market. We also run crews in Raleigh and the Triangle, Charlotte, Chicago and Los Angeles.
locationsBlock.closing: Moving between two of these cities, or to somewhere else entirely? That's a long distance move, and it gets a flat-rate quote.

reviews.heading: What Customers Say About Our Moving Services

faq.q: Can one quote cover packing, the move and storage?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us everything you need when you ask for a quote, and the manager prices the whole job together.

faq.q: Do you move just a few pieces of furniture?
faq.a: Yes. Small jobs fall under our 2-hour minimum that includes travel time, which is why furniture-only moves make sense with us.

faq.q: Which moves are priced by the hour and which at a flat rate?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added. Long distance moves are quoted at a flat rate.
Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up, so you pay for the space your things fill, not a fixed unit size.

faq.q: Are there moves you don't take on?
faq.a: We haven't listed junk removal, car shipping or international moves as services. Ask when you request a quote and we'll tell you plainly whether we can help.

faqClosing: Need more detail on billing or moving day? The FAQ page goes through both.

closing.h2: Tell Us the Move, We'll Price It
closing.body: Send your move date, home size and both addresses. A manager explains how the job is billed before anything is booked.
